_about: ASSET-001 Hive Brute STEP 3: the material recipe for every part (runtime = our COPIES of the vanilla materials; nothing vanilla is edited). Colours are multipliers; 'linear' = SetVector, 'srgb' = SetColor (Runic lesson 25).

body (Troll Body).albedo: repaint: read _MainTex back, apply kit/repaint/repaint.json with kit/repaint/troll_hive_mask.png (R bark, G extremities, B veins, A roots + mouth slit) and kit/repaint/troll_moss_mask.png (R moss); write a texture copy at 1024
body (Troll Body).emission: _EmissionMap = mask B x blight_colour (repaint.json), _EmissionColor white x emission_strength 0.9, _EMISSION on

eye (eye_globe)._EmissionMap: kit/eye/eye_globe_core_pupil_mask.png R (core) - the pupil (G) is 0 in R
eye (eye_globe)._MainTex: darken by (1 - 0.92 x mask G) where the pupil is (texture copy)

fangs (Troll Body islands: claws + teeth.vertex colours: kit/vertex_colors/fangs.json (multiply albedo; needs a vertex-colour-aware shader, or bake into a small texture copy)

branches (gd_king Elder islands)._MainTex: texture copy: saturation x0.2, then x(0.17, 0.145, 0.115) (weathered grey-brown, the pink out)

biome tint (BlightedWorldHeartAI.ApplyBi: OWNER DECISION: as coded it sets _Color = biome tint AND _EmissionColor = tint x2 on EVERY renderer - see previews/final_biome_blackforest_panel.png (left: _Color only, right: as coded - the whole Brute glows flat purple). Recommendation: exclude the sub-bosses, or tint _Color only.
